usedFor: Flow holds your projects and HubSpot holds your deals, so “New Project” in Flow can start “Create Deal” in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Flow, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A project kicked off in Flow gets a deal in HubSpot, so sales sees the work as it starts.

watchOut: “New Project” in Flow is polling, so “Create Deal” in HubSpot runs after a scheduled check.
